title: A CRM for a four-person consulting shop
variant: Dense one-screen argument, the picks as a ranked ledger
prompt: We're a four-person consulting shop. We track maybe 80 leads a year and a dozen active clients in a spreadsheet and it's breaking down. Which CRM should we move to? Budget is under $50 per seat per month, and it has to play nicely with Google Workspace.
note: Dense on purpose: the reader is a partner comparing on a laptop who wants the whole argument on about one screen, so every section below the title is text-sm with small margins and one focal layer. The picks are a ranked ledger rather than cards so the order is visible before a word is read, and the verdict is a two-column bordered band rather than a filled strip so the page opens quietly and the brand tone is spent only on the top row's rank circle and kicker.
